title: Word-timestamp caption aligner with drift report
summary: Retimes caption cues to spoken word timestamps (fuzzy token matching, interpolation for unrecognised cues, overlap repair) and reports per-cue drift against a 150 ms tolerance.
examples: Fix captions that stay on screen 12.8 s while the speech lasts 4 s
Report caption drift against TTS word times

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
